headline: Nvidia unveils Rubin HPC GPU at Supercomputing 2026
summary: Nvidia unveiled its Rubin HPC GPU at Supercomputing 2026, offering over 50,000 CUDA cores for agentic HPC workloads when it arrives in 2028, positioned to challenge AMD's 288 teraFLOPS MI430X.

claims.statement: Nvidia unveiled its Rubin HPC GPU at Supercomputing 2026.

sources.quote: Nvidia announces Rubin HPC GPU with 'record number of CUDA cores' at Supercomputing 2026
Nvidia unveils an HPC-optimized Rubin GPU to challenge AMD's 288 teraFLOPS MI430X

claims.statement: The Rubin GPU gives over 50,000 CUDA cores and will arrive in 2028.

sources.quote: This new GPU will give scientists, engineers, and analysts over 50,000 CUDA cores to speed up agentic HPC workloads when it arrives in 2028.

claims.statement: The Rubin GPU is positioned to challenge AMD's 288 teraFLOPS MI430X chip.
